name: McConnell AFB
description: Home of the 22nd Air Refueling Wing, McConnell AFB is a premier KC-46 Pegasus and KC-135 Stratotanker installation supporting global air refueling, airlift, and aeromedical evacuation. A Total Force base hosting the 931st Air Refueling Wing (AFRC) and 184th Wing (ANG).

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass through the Visitor Control Center.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit the 22nd Comptroller Squadron for travel voucher — in-processing brief every Wednesday at 0900 in room 302 at the Dole Center.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. Air Capital Inn offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Main (East) Gate on Kansas St is open 24/7. Family Housing Gate on Arnold St is open 24/7. West Gate on Salina Rd is Mon-Fri 0600-1800. Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Fri 0700-1600. REAL ID required for all visitors.

sections.body: Official installation resources plus refuelmcconnell.com for FSS programs and Military OneSource for relocation support.
